name: Passion Flower Extract
description: Passion Flower Extract (CAS 91770-48-8 ), also sourced and listed under Passiflora edulis ext., is a botanical extract derived from the passionflower plant. It delivers characteristic tropical fruit flavor notes used across food, beverage, cosmetic, and nutraceutical manufacturing. In beverage and confectionery production, it provides authentic passion fruit flavor to juices, nectars, hard candies, and flavored syrups where natural botanical labeling is a commercial priority. This ingredient is essential for high-quality food production. Nutraceutical and dietary supplement formulators incorporate it into capsules, softgels, and functional food formats targeting the natural wellness segment. It is highly valued for its versatility in various health-focused product applications. Personal care manufacturers use it as a botanical flavoring and fragrance component in lip care products, oral hygiene formulations, and scented skin preparations. It adds a distinct sensory profile to premium cosmetic lines. In pharmaceutical flavor masking, it contributes to palatability in liquid oral dosage forms and chewable tablets. This makes it a functional choice for improving patient compliance in pediatric and adult medicine. Passion Flower Extract is supplied as a spray-dried powder or liquid concentrate, with powder forms being the most common for dry blending and encapsulation applications. These formats ensure stability and ease of use. Standard grades include food-grade and cosmetic-grade specifications, with standardized extracts available defined by flavonoid content. We ensure all batches meet rigorous industry requirements for purity and performance. Packaging typically ranges from kilogram quantities to bulk drum supply to suit both development-scale and commercial production volumes.
